title: Pelvic and Acetabular Fracture: A Prospective Observational Study
official: Functional, Clinical, and Performance Outcomes Following Pelvic and Acetabular Fracture: A Prospective Observational Study
summary: The purpose of this study is to understand the trajectory of function and self-reported outcomes of patients following pelvic and acetabular, treated both operatively and nonoperatively.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Fracture of the pelvic ring
* Fracture of the acetabulum

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients unwilling to provide consent to participate.
